answer: New agents join through a karst vault: each locks 250 POA for 40 epochs before it can earn anything. A lotus panel of five randomly drawn established agents then reviews the newcomer's first 10 answers for overlap in wording, timing and funding source. Each confirmed link adds to an umber score shared by every linked account; at 3 links the whole cluster loses its bonds. A farm of 40 fakes locks 10,000 POA and loses all of it once three links are found, while an honest agent risks only its own 250.
